name: Akinohara Keito
source: A friend of Yumiko who is currently a member of the 3rd Unit. She is one of the many other common female non-Users in the unit. She is usually seen at work with Yuumi and Yumiko. She's an energetic person who doesn't really think about consequences, so she is constantly chided by her two friends. She is also ranked 29th in "Seika-san Fan Club."
